channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Chris Bell is questionable to return to Week 11 against the Bills with a chest injury.
item.description: Bell and Bills safety Damar Hamlin collided on a Hamlin interception in the second quarter. It seemed like Bell and Hamlin slammed their helmets into one another, but Bell’s injury designation says chest. It’s been a season of tough injury luck for Bell, who has battled a knee injury all season after having offseason surgery.-Eric Samulski

item.title: Charlie Kolar (concussion) is active for Week 11 against the Jets.
item.description: Kolar, David Njoku and Oronde Gadsden will form a three-player committee this afternoon. None of them warrant TE1 treatment, though they provide Justin Herbert with safety-blanket options and should help out in the run game.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Ladd McConkey (back) is active for Week 11 against the Jets.
item.description: McConkey’s injuries have made him difficult to trust this season, but the Chargers have funneled targets his way when active. He should be viewed as a WR3 with volume-based upside, now evidently healthy enough to play. The Chargers declared LB Daiyan Henley, CB Tarheeb Still, WR Brenen Thompson, S Kendall Williamson, G Alex Harkey and WR KeAndre Lambert-Smith inactive for Week 11 against the Jets.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Roschon Johnson suffered an ankle injury in the Bears’ Week 11 game against the Saints and is doubtful to return.
item.description: Johnson was carted to the locker room in the first quarter against the Saints. He was announced to have an ankle injury and is doubtful to return. With Kyle Monangai back, the Bears had depth in the backfield again but lose a special teamer and third-string running back in Johnson against the Saints.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Lions declared CB D.J. Reed, CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr., DB Ketih Abney II, LB Amen Ogbongbemiga, EDGE Tyrus Wheat, and DL Mekhi Wingo inactive for Week 11 against the Bucs.
item.description: Reed made seven starts this year before injuring his hip a few weeks ago. Rakestraw has been a depth option so far, but that would have been useful to have around with Reed out. The Lions’ defense will be as vulnerable as ever this week, though it’s anyone’s guess as to whether a hobbled Baker Mayfield will take advantage.-Kyle Dvorchak

item.title: Dolphins declared S Dante Trader Jr., CB Jaylin Simpson, P Bradley Pinion, OL Christian Haynes, OL Caedan Wallace, TE Justin Joly, and WR Jared Wayne inactive for Week 11 against the Bills.
item.description: Trader Jr. is the Dolphins’ starting strong safety, but the rest of the inactives are depth pieces. Simpson does see the field as a backup cornerback, so the Dolphins will be down two members of the secondary in a game against Josh Allen, which is never great news.-Eric Samulski

item.title: Tyrell Shavers (knee) is active and will make his season debut in Week 11 against the Dolphins.
item.description: Shavers has been sidelined all season after tearing his ACL in a playoff win over Jacksonville last year. The 27-year-old had emerged as the team’s best blocking wide receiver last year and had seen his snap count increase as the season went on. He’s unlikely to be a fantasy factor, but it would not be surprising to see him play a decent amount of snaps once he is fully ramped up because of the value he provides in the running game. This means rookie Skyler Bell is back to being a game-day inactive.-Eric Samulski

item.title: Dalton Kincaid is inactive for Week 11 against the Dolphins.
item.description: Kincaid was listed as questionable with (thumb/ankle) injuries, but he will not suit up. This makes sense as a cautionary move for the Bills, who already ruled out starting cornerback Christian Benford and starting linebacker Dorian Williams. The Bills are nearly a 17-point favorite against the Dolphins on Sunday and then will face the Chiefs on Thursday night. Except Dawson Knox to be more involved in this game in Week 11, but we wouldn’t be surprised if the Bills are running the ball a lot in the second half. The Bills’ full inactives are: WR Skyler Bell, TE Dalton Kincaid, OT Jude Bowry, DL T.J. Sanders, ILB Dorian Williams, OLB Mike Danna, and CB Christian Benford.-Eric Samulski

item.title: Roman Wilson (finger) is active for Week 11 against the Eagles.
item.description: Wilson, who accounted for 16 percent of the Steelers’ targets and 39 percent of the team’s air yards before sustaining a finger injury in Week 5, will make his return to the lineup and likely make Germie Bernard all but unplayable in 12-team leagues. Wilson can be slotted in as a high-variance flex or second flex against the Eagles. The Steelers declared WR Kaden Wetjen, QBs Drew Allar Will Howard, Sean Murphy-Bunting, RB Eli Heidenreich, OLB Nick Herbig, and DL Gabe Rubio inactive.-Denny Carter

item.title: Chiefs declared RB Kenneth Walker (groin) inactive for Kansas City’s Week 11 game against the Cardinals.
item.description: It’s Emmett Johnson szn once more. Also inactive for the Chiefs are QB Garrett Nussmeier (third quarterback), OL Jaylon Moore (ankle), OL Trey Smith (concussion), DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee), DT Peter Woods (neck) and CB Melvin Smith. Norman-Lott and Woods were both questionable and will not play. The others were ruled out on Friday.-Rivers McCown
